about_the_game:
In the Western Kingdom of Tavernar, on the continent of Avelir, beyond the mountains, a path was forged to the magical forests. These forests became a new frontier for the development of magic and research. It was there that the deepest dungeon ever known was discovered — and several factions established their bases above it, beginning their descent into its abyss.

You are one of the adventurers who decided to step into the forgotten darkness, where traps, monsters, and ancient secrets lurk in the shadows. CaveVox is a first-person voxel-style roguelike set in a fantasy dungeon. Brutal. Atmospheric. Unpredictable.

In this demo, you will explore several of the first dungeon levels. No two runs are the same — corridors, rooms, and items are regenerated to keep every expedition fresh. Venture into the dark, uncharted depths and face the monsters that lurk within.

Features in the demo:

  • Dynamic first-person combat — Use melee weapons to survive.

  • Permadeath and tough choices — Every decision has consequences. Mistakes are fatal.

  • Procedural world — Randomly generated levels, items, and enemies. Explore the world at your own pace and in your own way.

  • Spatial audio — Hear approaching enemies and ambient sounds that immerse you in the environment.

  • Living world — Interact with the environment: light or extinguish candles, search for hidden passages and caches.

  • Single-player experience — Venture into the dungeon alone. Cooperative mode will be available in the full release.

CaveVox is actively in development. Join early and help shape the game with your feedback.
